capacity_detail.basis: Cleanview lists 71 MW each for Digital Dulles Building 6 and Building 8; local government sources confirm site/building records but do not disclose MW.

contradictions.description: Assigned record names Buildings 6 and 8. Loudoun parcel records confirm land units/owners for Building 6 and Building 8 at 43705 and 43715 Efficiency Dr, but Loudoun permit text for 43715 Efficiency Dr labels the fit-up as IAD 045 Building 9. Kept the assigned project name and noted the permit-label mismatch.

Cleanview still labels both buildings planned, while Loudoun permits/property records show Building 6 shell plus tenant fit-out permits and Building 8 a 2025 assessor building record. Status follows higher-priority local government evidence.
